description: Get the CUE SHEET for a track — album, catalog number, ISRC, tempo, key, publisher, and every writer with their IPI, society and performance share. Hand this over when the user needs delivery paperwork, rights information, or asks who wrote it. AINSOF controls master and publishing, so these are stated facts, not estimates.
